reason: I'd only do the £4.95 trial pack. It's cheap, it's properly halal, and I don't have to sign up to a subscription. I'm not paying £18 a pouch until I know it does something for my knees, and the pouch only talks about skin and hair, not joints.
objection: It says nothing about joints, which is my actual problem, and £18 a month adds up when Amazon and Holland & Barrett always have collagen on offer. Plus I don't want to get pushed into a subscription I forget to cancel.
would_change_my_mind: A bigger discount on a one-off pouch with no subscription, like a 3-for-2 or a launch deal on Amazon, plus some clear evidence it helps with joints.
